blocks.text: Surrey condos and townhomes by price band, September 2026

114 condos and townhomes sold in September against 1,523 listed. The price band with the most sales was $300,001 to $400,000, with 25 sold (22% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $200,001 to $300,000 at 13%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Bands with nothing listed and nothing sold are left out. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Surrey real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Surrey?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 1,523 condos and townhomes listed in Surrey and 114 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 7%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for condos and townhomes in Surrey?
faq.a: The September report gave $512,944 for condos and townhomes in Surrey, against $560,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Surrey?
faq.a: The September report showed 25 days on market for condos and townhomes in Surrey and a sale-to-list price ratio of 99%, against 32 days the month before.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Surrey?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Surrey?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.
